editorial:
A live-action take on the popular cartoon brings a fun, fast-paced adventure to your screen. You follow Ben Tennyson and his cousin Gwen as they team up with a mysterious girl from Ben's past to stop an alien threat from destroying the world. The vibe is exciting and family-friendly, with plenty of action and humor. It feels like a Saturday morning cartoon come to life, which is exactly what fans want. Even newcomers can jump in and enjoy the ride.

The acting is solid for a TV movie, and the action scenes keep things moving at a good clip. The alien effects look a bit dated now, but they still get the job done. On the plus side, the story is easy to follow and the characters are likable. On the downside, the budget shows in some scenes, and the plot is pretty simple. If you are a Ben 10 fan or want a fun family movie night, this is a good pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: Ben discovers that the mysterious girl, Elena, is connected to the alien swarm. The aliens are using nanite technology to control people and spread across the world. In the final battle, Ben uses his alien forms to fight through the swarm and destroy the main hive. Elena helps him, and together they stop the invasion. The world is saved, and Ben learns to trust his friends and his past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family-friendly sci-fi action and cartoon adaptations.
